guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is low, on the active clock edge, low_then_high_q, dom_out_low_q, and dom_in_low_q are set to 0.
When rst_ni is high, on every positive clock edge, low_then_high_q loads low_then_high_d, dom_out_low_q loads dom_out_low_d, and dom_in_low_q loads dom_in_low_d.

uncertain_points.claim: The signals dom_out_low_d and dom_in_low_d appear to be domain‑crossing indicators (names suggest 'domain out low' and 'domain in low'). This register block does not enforce synchronization; safe operation depends on upstream synchronization of these signals.
uncertain_points.risk: If dom_out_low_d or dom_in_low_d are asynchronous or multi‑cycle, metastability or data corruption may propagate to dom_out_low_q and dom_in_low_q.
